select t.*, sum(t.daily_sales) over (partition by sale_month,customer_code order by t.sale_date) as monthly_cumulative_sales from ( SELECT t5.code customer_code, t5.name customer_name, t7.code zone_code, t7.name zone_name, t6.code area_name, t6.name area_code, t8.code dept_code, t8.name dept_name, t4.pk_psndoc employee_pk, t4.code employee_code, t4.name employee_name, substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 7) AS sale_month, substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 10) AS sale_date, SUM(t2.nnum) daily_sales /*单位是kg*/ FROM nc65.ic_saleout_h t1 /*销售出库*/ LEFT JOIN nc65.ic_saleout_b t2 ON t2.cgeneralhid = t1.cgeneralhid LEFT JOIN nc65.bd_custsale t3 ON t3.pk_customer = t1.ccustomerid AND t3.def6 = 'Y' LEFT JOIN nc65.bd_psndoc t4 ON t4.pk_psndoc = t3.respperson left join nc65.bd_customer t5 on t5.pk_customer = t3.pk_customer join nc65.org_orgs t6 on t3.pk_org = t6.pk_org /*销售大区*/ join nc65.org_salesorg t7 on t7.pk_salesorg = t6.glbdef7 /*战区层级*/ left join nc65.org_dept t8 on t8.pk_dept = t3.respdept
WHERE t1.dr = 0 AND t2.dr = 0 AND t1.fbillflag = 3 AND t2.flargess = 'N' /*排除赠品*/ /*and substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 10) >= '2023-10-01'*/ and t4.code is not null and substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 10) between #{timeRange[0]} and #{timeRange[1]} group by t5.code,t5.name,t7.code,t7.name,t6.code, t6.name,t8.name, t8.code,t4.code,t4.pk_psndoc,t4.name,substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 10),substr(t2.dbizdate, 1, 7) ) t

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, rank() over ( PARTITION BY customer_code ORDER BY monthly_cumulative_sales DESC ) rk FROM sale_customer_sales_detail t WHERE sale_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} and deleted = '0'
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND zone_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{zoneName}, '%')
/*areaName*/
AND area_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{areaName}, '%')
AND employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
) temp WHERE rk = 1
